title: Week 10 final scores missing from pack results feeds
what_we_observed: Official schedule page prints 9 Week 10 games as Final (WAS-NYG plus eight Sunday games). The d966, f4, market and 6cef feeds hold only WAS-NYG for Week 10; 309921cc holds WAS-NYG as final and marks the other games scheduled; a411fed0 has no Week 10 rows.
why_it_matters: Backtests and ROI computed from these feeds omit eight final games. Any ROI is computed on an incomplete corpus.
does_it_block_merge: no - the published feeds carry the gap as a visible incompleteness; it is not a fabricated value

title: Three designation conflicts in 309921cc and nfl_wk
what_we_observed: Official report (DET block): Kerby Joseph Did Not Participate In Practice, game status Out; Sione Vaki Limited Participation, game status Questionable; Amon-Ra St. Brown Limited Participation, game status Questionable. 309921cc and nfl_wk print Joseph as Full Participation in Practice; Vaki as Did Not Participate In Practice with game status blank; St. Brown with game status blank.
why_it_matters: A practice-trend or DNP-to-FP series built from these files would show false recoveries and drop the questionable tags.
does_it_block_merge: no - the conflicts are recorded; the official values are the ones published here

title: No automated capture or immutable snapshot path
what_we_observed: No scheduled job, raw-hash ledger, or fetch-time column exists. This sandbox allows outbound access only to github.com, codeload, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org, so nfl.com cannot be read from scripts here. Official pages were read only with the page-fetch tool.
evidence_and_where: Sandbox allowlist (session environment); src/nfl_d966f630/cache.py has no hashing; no workflow captures NFL pages.
why_it_matters: Multi-day replay of what was known and when is impossible without it. Brief items B30-B31 and B42 depend on it.

title: Week 10 injury row counts differ across packs
what_we_observed: Week 10 rows: 326 in 309921cc and nfl_wk, 347 in a411 and d966, 50 in nfl_market. The 254 and 279 counts named in the brief appear in no pack. The official row count was not fully counted in this session: the injury page has 8 chunks and only chunk 0 (four clubs) was read.
evidence_and_where: data/nfl_e5e38f9e/injury_pack_comparison.csv; pack files named in brief_trace.csv B44
why_it_matters: Counts disagree by 21 rows between packs with the same source; a reader cannot tell which pack is complete.
does_it_block_merge: no - recorded; the official count is open

title: Combined leaderboard shows backtest units beside signal rank
what_we_observed: data/nfl_d966f630/leaderboard_combined.csv carries units_total, max_drawdown_units and n_tickets_graded beside signal rank. docs/nfl-d966f630/leaderboard.html and gates.html publish those columns. The brief requires signal and staking to be separated and backtest numbers kept off the leaderboard.
why_it_matters: A lucky staking run can rank a strategy above a weak signal on this page. The brief forbids this.
does_it_block_merge: no - recorded; fix belongs to the owning pack

title: STR-01 recorded as live without price evidence
what_we_observed: data/nfl_d966f630/strategy_states.csv records D966-STR-01 with decision promote_to_live, state live, effective 2026-11-14. The same pack records no market price for any market (D966-F01), so no bet on STR-01 can be settled against a price.
why_it_matters: A strategy is live with no price record; the demotion gate should send it back to paper until a price exists.
does_it_block_merge: no - recorded for owner decision (suggestion E5-S03)

title: Roster turnover / reserve list / announced starters are not captured
what_we_observed: No table holds injured-reserve status, a transactions log, or an announced-starter field. Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley are named as stale-depth cases in pack flags, but no official transaction was read to confirm them. The brief's VR/VQ review IDs for these cases do not resolve (E5-F14).
evidence_and_where: Headers checked across data/nfl*; names appear in data/nfl_6cefc476 and data/nfl_origination flags
why_it_matters: A 'not listed' result can be read as 'available' when the player is on injured reserve.

title: Depth coverage is 28 of 32 clubs and mostly image-or-unread
what_we_observed: The d966 club depth rollup lists 28 clubs; CHI, DEN, PHI and TB are absent because they had byes in Week 10. The a411 pack records that only 4 of 32 club depth charts rendered as extractable text and that the Texans depth chart is an image (its flag A4-F03). The Texans image was not re-read in this session.
why_it_matters: The brief requires 32-club verification before any team-level model is trusted. Route (a) of the brief is not complete.
does_it_block_merge: no - the brief's own gate remains closed

title: Price-data policy and strategy registration commits not recorded
what_we_observed: The price-data question (D966-Q01) is marked needs_owner_input. No strategy row carries a registration commit hash, so pre-registration cannot be checked from the repo.
why_it_matters: Without a dated rule commit a strategy can be redefined after results are seen.

title: Some rows cite github.com as the source and the raw rows sit in the public site
what_we_observed: data/nfl_d966f630/decision_ledger.csv and questions.csv cite github.com as the official source for decisions. Raw row-level injury and price tables are published in data/ and docs/ with no private layer.
why_it_matters: The brief requires every table row to cite an official page and raw rows to sit in a private store until terms are read.

title: Venue not verified from the official game centre
what_we_observed: Venue fields exist in nfl_wk/slate.csv and nfl_origination/week10_slate_and_lines.csv. The game-centre pages were not read in this session.
why_it_matters: Venue cannot be marked verified; brief item B24 stays open.

title: Designation play rates / inactive lists / snap counts / game books not captured
what_we_observed: No table holds official inactive lists, snap counts or game-book rows. Designation-to-play rates therefore cannot be measured, and 'Questionable' stays uncalibrated.
evidence_and_where: Headers checked across data/nfl*; game books named in 8 files but none captured
why_it_matters: The brief's depth-from-playing-time / starter-proxy / designation-reliability items cannot be built.

title: No holdout seasons; one season in every table
what_we_observed: Every NFL table covers the 2026 season only (weeks 1-10 at most). No train, validation or final holdout split exists.
why_it_matters: Walk-forward and holdout claims rest on one season and cannot isolate skill from luck.

title: Brief's VR/VQ review identifiers do not resolve in the repo
what_we_observed: The identifiers VR-04, VR-08, VR-17, VR-24, VQ-05, VQ-08 appear in no file in this repository (repo search, 0 hits). The brief's references to them cannot be traced.
evidence_and_where: Repo search across the full working tree

does_it_block_merge: no - the brief owner should supply the review file

title: Joseph Ossai (NYJ) practice status conflicts across packs
what_we_observed: Official NYJ block not read in this session. d966 and a411 print Full Participation in Practice with game status Questionable; 309921cc and nfl_wk print Limited Participation in Practice with game status blank.
why_it_matters: Two packs carry a different designation for the same player-week. Which is right needs the official NYJ block.
does_it_block_merge: no - recorded; a verification read of the NYJ block would resolve it

title: Third-party DraftKings prices marked verified in nfl_f4; other packs refuse them
what_we_observed: data/nfl_f4/price_snapshots.csv holds 168 Week 10 rows with American odds (for example -110) from DraftKings via an ESPN odds endpoint (sports.core.api.espn.com), each with status verified. The nfl_market pack (data/nfl_market/price_snapshots.csv, status_detail) says a third-party book would breach the project official-source-only rule and leaves its cells blank. The two packs disagree on the same policy.
evidence_and_where: data/nfl_f4/price_snapshots.csv; data/nfl_market/price_snapshots.csv (status_detail); data/nfl_d966f630/flagged.csv D966-F01; data/nfl_309921cc/price_snapshots.csv (blank by policy)
why_it_matters: Verified is a label the official-source rule cannot give to a third-party odds endpoint. Any edge or ROI computed from these prices rests on a source the repo says it does not use. This pack publishes no price.
does_it_block_merge: no - recorded for owner decision (question Q-E5-01 and suggestion E5-S11); this pack publishes no price
